candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout and 502 checkout responses.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres server-side metrics or pool wait counters; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s preceded by order ReadTimeout, with postgres.save_order failing DependencyUnavailable while pool size 5 and idle 0. Gateway metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms order->postgresql dependency. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion.
